items.question: Which result follows for a man within a mere month?
premises: The time is a mere month.
items.inference: The rite yields an ornamented maiden to a man within a month.
uncertainties: Exact ritual context is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: A man obtains an ornamented maiden within a mere month.
